sources.note: The preamble names the association and its short name; Artikel 1 lists the nine parts that make up the rules in one book. The book names no course of fire: the courses are set by each event's own plan, so no discipline has a record.
The rules rest on the shooting ordinances of the Swiss Federal Council and the federal defence department.
